content_sections.heading: About Amrita Research Assistant
content_sections.text: Amrita Vishwa Vidyapeetham is conducting recruitment for Research Assistant positions at its Amritapuri Campus. The selected candidates will work under the Amrita Darshanam International Centre for Spiritual Studies. The primary mandate of the role is to contribute to 'The Critical Edition of the Ashtadhyayi' project through manuscript analysis and academic research.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: There are a total of 2 vacancies available for the Research Assistant post under the project. FREEJOBALERT DAILY QUIZ Preparing for Govt Exams? Test Yourself! 25 Questions · 20 Minutes · Instant Score Take Today's Free Quiz →

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must possess a Postgraduate (PG) degree in Sanskrit with a specialization in Grammar (minimum 55% score) along with NET/M.Phil./Ph.D.

content_sections.heading: Amrita Research Assistant Job Description
content_sections.text: The basic requirement of this post is to assist in the project titled- ‘The Critical Edition of the Ashtadhyayi’ under Amrita Darshanam International Centre for Spiritual Studies, Amrita Vishwa Vidyapeetham. Academic contributions, in any form, to the project, are expected from the employee assiduously. The position which has been assigned to you requires the execution of the following things diligently- Assisting in the aforesaid project (under Amrita Darshanam ICSS) in form of: Collecting the manuscripts. Reading and copying the manuscripts manually as well as digitally. Collating the manuscript contents. Any other relevant academic work related to the project. Research part of the critical edition of the Ashtadhyayi with respect to examining the manuscripts and working in accordance with the traditional as well modern commentaries.
